mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMTNLEADERSCHDUL ( SCHDUL_ID, SCHDUL_SE, SCHDUL_NM, SCHDUL_CN, SCHDUL_PLACE, LEADER_ID, REPTIT_SE_CODE, SCHDUL_BGNDE, SCHDUL_ENDDE, SCHDUL_CHARGER_ID, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, CAL_ID, RESERVED_ROOM ) VALUES ( #{schdulId}, #{schdulSe}, #{schdulNm}, #{schdulCn}, #{schdulPlace}, #{leaderId}, #{reptitSeCode}, #{schdulBgnde}, #{schdulEndde}, #{schdulChargerId}, #{frstRegisterId}, #{lastUpdusrId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{calId}, #{reservedRoom} )
mapper.select: SELECT s.SCHDUL_ID AS "schdul_id", s.SCHDUL_NM AS "title", CASE WHEN s.SCHDUL_BGNDE IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(s.SCHDUL_BGNDE)) = 14 THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(s.SCHDUL_BGNDE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE NULL END AS "start_dt", CASE WHEN s.SCHDUL_ENDDE IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(s.SCHDUL_ENDDE)) = 14 THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(s.SCHDUL_ENDDE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE NULL END AS "end_dt", s.SCHDUL_PLACE AS "schdul_place", s.SCHDUL_CN AS "schdul_cn", s.CAL_ID AS "calId", c.COLOR AS "color" FROM COMTNLEADERSCHDUL s JOIN CALENDAR c ON s.CAL_ID = c.CAL_ID WHERE TRIM(c.OWNER_ID) = #{ownerId} OR c.CAL_ID IN ( SELECT CAL_ID FROM CALSHARE WHERE MBER_ID = #{ownerId} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CALENDAR ( CAL_ID, CAL_NAME, COLOR, NOTE, ADD_DE, POST_DE, OWNER_ID ) VALUES ( #{calId}, #{calName}, #{color}, 'test', SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{ownerId} )
mapper.select: SELECT TRIM(cal_id) AS cal_id, TRIM(cal_name) AS cal_name, TRIM(color) AS color, TRIM(owner_id) AS owner_id FROM CALENDAR WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} OR cal_id IN ( SELECT cal_id FROM calshare WHERE mber_id = #{ownerId} ) ORDER BY cal_name

SELECT m.MTGRUM_ID, m.MTGRUM_NM FROM COMTNMTGPLACEMANAGE m WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COMTNLEADERSCHDUL s WHERE s.RESERVED_ROOM = m.MTGRUM_ID AND s.SCHDUL_BGNDE <= #{reserveDateTime} AND s.SCHDUL_ENDDE > #{reserveDateTime} ) ORDER BY m.MTGRUM_NM
SELECT TRIM(MTGRUM_ID) AS MTGRUM_ID, TRIM(MTGRUM_NM) AS MTGRUM_NM FROM COMTNMTGPLACEMANAGE ORDER BY MTGRUM_NM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CALSHARE ( SHARE_ID, AUTHORITY, CAL_ID, MBER_ID, SH_DE ) VALUES ( #{shareId}, #{authority}, TRIM(#{calId}), TRIM(#{mberId}), SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT TRIM(c.CAL_ID) AS cal_id, TRIM(c.CAL_NAME) AS cal_name, TRIM(c.COLOR) AS color, TRIM(c.OWNER_ID) AS owner_id, TRIM(cs.MBER_ID) AS shared_to FROM CALENDAR c JOIN CALSHARE cs ON TRIM(c.CAL_ID) = TRIM(cs.CAL_ID) WHERE TRIM(cs.MBER_ID) = #{loginId}
mapper.update: UPDATE COMTNLEADERSCHDUL SET SCHDUL_NM = #{schdulNm}, SCHDUL_CN = #{schdulCn}, SCHDUL_PLACE = #{schdulPlace}, SCHDUL_BGNDE = #{schdulBgnde}, SCHDUL_ENDDE = #{schdulEndde}, RESERVED_ROOM = #{reservedRoom}, LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{lastUpdusrId}, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE TRIM(SCHDUL_ID) = TRIM(#{schdulId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM COMTNLEADERSCHDUL WHERE TRIM(SCHDUL_ID) = TRIM(#{schdulId})
mapper.select: SELECT TRIM(s.SCHDUL_ID) AS schdulId, TRIM(s.SCHDUL_NM) AS schdulNm, TRIM(s.SCHDUL_CN) AS schdulCn, TRIM(s.SCHDUL_PLACE) AS schdulPlace, TRIM(s.SCHDUL_BGNDE) AS schdulBgnde, TRIM(s.SCHDUL_ENDDE) AS schdulEndde, TRIM(s.CAL_ID) AS calId, TRIM(s.RESERVED_ROOM) AS roomId, TRIM(r.MTGRUM_NM) AS roomName FROM COMTNLEADERSCHDUL s LEFT JOIN COMTNMTGPLACEMANAGE r ON s.RESERVED_ROOM = r.MTGRUM_ID WHERE TRIM(s.SCHDUL_ID) = TRIM(#{schdulId})
